name: taiwan-ott-searcher
description: 台灣 OTT 搜尋平台 — 搜尋電影與影集，在台灣哪裡可以看

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
